summary: Tested Infinit-Audit Traceability Document Builder end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass covering template CRUD, version auto-increment, document create/submit, list, filter, PDF export, and 404s. Frontend: login, sidebar nav, template card visibility, designer with 5 field types (text/number/time/checkbox/blank), min/max validation config, up/down reordering, save+list, edit+version bump (v1→v2 visible in card), Fill-In flow, submit + toast, Completed tab, view page (title header + metadata footer + PDF download), delete template dialog + confirmation all verified working.

minor.issue: No DELETE endpoint for documents. Users cannot remove created/in-progress documents; each 'Fill In' click creates a new document that persists in 'In Progress' tab even if never submitted.
Deleting a template does not cascade or reject if completed documents reference it. Orphan documents remain in Completed tab (though snapshot fields on doc allow PDF export to still work).

ui_bugs.issue: Required checkbox validation is weak: when a checkbox is required but left unchecked, values[f.id] becomes false which passes the `val === '' || null || undefined` check, allowing submit. Should also explicitly reject `false` for required checkboxes.

issues: Two similar-sounding nav items 'Traceability' and 'Documents' — potentially confusing for users. Consider clarifying labels or merging.
Field type dropdown value 'Blank Field' shows as 'Blank Field' in dropdown but underlying value is 'blank' — small inconsistency (cosmetic).
Every click on 'Fill In' creates a new document row in 'In Progress' tab even when user immediately backs out; no cleanup mechanism (see backend minor issue).

passed_tests: Backend: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/traceability/templates - full CRUD
Backend: Template version starts at 1 and auto-increments on each PUT
Backend: POST /api/traceability/documents creates doc snapshot from template (title, ref, version, authorised_by, fields)
Backend: PUT /api/traceability/documents/{id} sets completed=true and completed_at
Backend: GET /api/traceability/documents with template_id filter
Backend: GET /api/traceability/documents/{id}/pdf returns valid PDF (>500 bytes, starts with %PDF)
Backend: 404 for nonexistent template/document
Backend: Seeded 'Production Line Checklist' (SD-PLC-001) with 6 fields is present
Frontend: Admin login with admin@infinit-audit.co.uk
Frontend: Sidebar 'Documents' nav navigates to /documents
Frontend: Templates tab shows Production Line Checklist card with SD-PLC-001 badge and v1
Frontend: 'New Template' button navigates to /documents/design
Frontend: Designer accepts title, doc reference, adds 5 fields with different types (Text, Number, Time, Checkbox, Blank Field)
Frontend: Min/Max Characters (text) and Min/Max Value (number) validation inputs are present and configurable
Frontend: Up/Down reorder buttons swap field positions correctly
Frontend: Save Template creates new template and returns to /documents list
Frontend: New template card shows title, doc ref badge, version badge (v1)
Frontend: Edit button loads existing template with populated title/ref/fields
Frontend: Saving an edited template shows 'Template updated (version incremented)' toast; version badge becomes v2 in card
Frontend: Fill In button creates a new document and navigates to /documents/fill/:docId
Frontend: Filled document submit -> 'Document completed!' toast; navigates to /documents; Completed count increments
Frontend: Completed tab lists submitted documents; clicking one opens /documents/view/:docId
Frontend: View page shows title header, doc reference, version, authorised by, and completed date
Frontend: 'Download PDF' triggers PDF download with filename '<docRef>.pdf'
Frontend: Trash icon on template card opens Delete confirmation dialog
Frontend: 'Delete' button in dialog removes template from list
action_items: (LOW) Fix required-checkbox validation in DocumentFill.js submitDocument: treat unchecked (false) checkbox as invalid when field.required is true.
(LOW) Add DELETE endpoint for /api/traceability/documents/{doc_id} so admins/users can clean up abandoned in-progress documents.
(LOW) Consider preventing template deletion when completed documents reference it, or add a warning; alternatively, cascade delete.
(NICE-TO-HAVE) 'Fill In' should not create a new document until the user actually starts entering values, to avoid orphan 'In Progress' records.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1894 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline threshold; recommend splitting into modules (auth, audits, traceability, dashboard, users) for maintainability.

TraceabilityDocumentCreate (POST /traceability/documents) uses `data: dict` instead of a Pydantic model — bypasses validation. Recommend defining a TraceabilityDocumentCreate model with required template_id.

PUT /traceability/templates unconditionally increments version on every update, even if nothing changed (e.g., re-saving with same content). Consider only bumping when fields/title/ref actually differ.

Traceability field IDs are regenerated on every template PUT — this breaks referential integrity with previously-created documents' field_values (though docs snapshot their own fields, so it's OK for existing docs; new docs will get new IDs).
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_UI_Template (via UI). Backend pytest creates/deletes TEST_Traceability_Template, TEST_DocFlow_Template automatically. One orphan completed document remains in Completed tab referencing the now-deleted TEST_UI_Template.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All traceability document builder features work correctly. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_traceability.py cover template CRUD, version increment, document lifecycle, PDF export. Only cosmetic and minor improvements suggested. A stale completed document for 'TEST_UI_Template' exists in the DB (template deleted but doc remains) — safe to ignore.
